items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1965-09-13
items.q: Very much. Oh yes, yes, definitely with Art Tatum. I was definitely taken up with him.

ctx.x: Did you take up, were you taken up much by Art Tatum's style?
Very much. Oh yes, yes, definitely with Art Tatum. I was definitely taken up with him. I first heard him I think around 36 or 37, something like that.
Who do you like or do you have any taste for the modern jazz pianists of today? Do you find any kinship with them in particular?
